linear_programming_feasible_region_desc: The feasible region is the set of all points that satisfy all constraints simultaneously. It is typically a convex polygon in two dimensions, bounded by the constraint lines.
linear_programming_objective_function_de: The objective function is the linear function to be maximized or minimized. The optimal solution occurs at a corner point (vertex) of the feasible region.
linear_programming_simplex_method_desc: The simplex method is an iterative algorithm that moves from one corner point to an adjacent one, improving the objective function value at each step until the optimal solution is reached.
linear_programming_duality_desc: Every linear programming problem has a corresponding dual problem. The optimal values of the primal and dual problems are equal under certain conditions (strong duality theorem).
